note: W10 (OKNA §8.3): presets of the measurement harness e2e/windows-perf-native.mjs. Window counts and the panels opened are examples of the space (open lists; LOOM_PERF_COUNTS=1,4,8,16,32 runs other counts). The numbers it prints are dated observations of one machine and one browser (headless Chromium here, not WebView on a phone). `gross` are thresholds of a gross regression only: crossing one prints a warning and fails only with LOOM_PERF_STRICT=1 (report-only by default, never a flaky gate).
